manifest.name: driver-dnf
manifest.description: Predict the if each driver will DNF (not finish) a race in the next 1 month.
manifest.sql:
SELECT
    t.timestamp as date,
    re.driverId as driverId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN re.statusId != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS did_not_finish
FROM
    timestamps t
LEFT JOIN
    results re
ON
    re.date <= t.timestamp + INTERVAL '{timedelta}'
    and re.date  > t.timestamp
WHERE
    re.driverId IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT driverId
        FROM results
        WHERE date > t.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 year'
    )
GROUP BY t.timestamp, re.driverId
